# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This repository is a personal fork / portfolio mirror. The canonical repository is [techieswithoutborders/CMES-AI](https://github.com/techieswithoutborders/CMES-AI).

**Please report security vulnerabilities to the canonical repo**, not here.

This system is **not validated for clinical decision-making**. See the CRITICAL SAFETY NOTICE in this README and `SAFETY.md` before any use.

Do not open security advisories on this fork. Issues and pull requests on this repository will not be answered or merged.
